explanation: The theorem is the Ky Fan k-sum triangle inequality for the sum of the top k singular values. Mathlib's only singular-value file is Analysis/InnerProductSpace/SingularValues.lean. It has basic API (nonneg, antitone, support, zero) but no sum inequality, no Ky Fan norm and no subadditivity of singular values. A grep for kyFan (case-insensitive) in Mathlib found matches only in that file and NormDet.lean, and both are singularValues matches rather than Ky Fan results.
